## Overview

::: {.callout-important}
## Focus for today
This lab is **Phase 1** of the [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd). You will draft the **core documents** needed before data collection. Labs 17 and 18 complete the toolkit so you are ready for **data collection in Week 19**.
:::

**Phase 1 (this week):** Draft Participant Information Sheet, Consent Form, Debrief Form, Participant Instructions, and **start** the Researcher Procedure.

**Phase 2 (Week 18):** Recruitment Script, Data Recording Sheet, finalise Stimulus Materials, **complete** Researcher Procedure, practice run, Research Study Order Form.

---

## Before You Start

1. Open the [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd) and bookmark it.
2. Download the **blank templates** from the toolkit (or use the links in the checklist below).
3. Have your **research question**, **design** (between/within), and **procedure** (what participants do) clear — from your Research Plan (submitted Week 16).

---

## Phase 1 Checklist

Use this checklist as you work through the session. Tick off each item as your group completes it.

### 1. Participant Information Sheet

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Participant Information Sheet — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-participant-information-sheet.docx)
- [ ] Filled in **purpose** of the study (general terms — no hypothesis)
- [ ] Described **what will happen** (steps, approximate time)
- [ ] Included **right to withdraw**, **confidentiality**, **contact for questions**
- [ ] Language is accessible (no jargon)
- [ ] Saved with a consistent filename (e.g. `YourProject_Participant_Information_Sheet`)

**Reference:** Worked example in [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd) → Document checklist → 1. Participant Information Sheet.

---

### 2. Consent Form

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Consent Form — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-consent-form.docx)
- [ ] **Study title** matches the Information Sheet and all other documents
- [ ] Saved; plan to print ~30 copies for data collection

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 2. Consent Form.

---

### 3. Debrief Form

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Debrief Form — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-debrief-form.docx)
- [ ] Explained **true purpose** and **hypothesis** (you may reveal these here)
- [ ] Brief **theory** or background (e.g. why this design)
- [ ] **Data withdrawal** instructions and **support** contacts included
- [ ] Kept to about one page
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 3. Debrief Form.

---

### 4. Participant Instructions

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Participant Instructions — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-participant-instructions.docx)
- [ ] **Numbered steps** in plain language
- [ ] **No hypothesis** or what you expect to find
- [ ] Short (about half a page)
- [ ] If between- and within-subjects differ, separate instruction sheets as needed
- [ ] Saved

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 7. Participant Instructions.

---

### 5. Researcher Procedure (Start)

- [ ] Downloaded template: [Researcher Procedure — Template](../../files/project-docs/templates/template-researcher-procedure.docx)
- [ ] **Materials checklist** completed (everything needed on the day)
- [ ] **Sequence** written: greeting → consent → instructions → main task → debrief
- [ ] **Timing** for each phase (study period, distractor, recall, etc.)
- [ ] **Exact wording** for key instructions (in quotes or italics)
- [ ] Saved — you will **complete** this in Week 18 (data recording, scoring, etc.)

**Reference:** Project Toolkit → 8. Researcher Procedure.

---

## Group Roles (Optional)

To speed things up, you can divide tasks:

| Role | Focus |
|------|--------|
| Person A | Information Sheet + Consent |
| Person B | Debrief Form |
| Person C | Participant Instructions |
| Person D | Researcher Procedure (start) |

Then **swap and review** so everyone agrees on wording and consistency (especially study title).

---

## Consistency Check

Before you leave, verify:

- **Study title** is identical on Information Sheet, Consent Form, Debrief, and Procedure.
- **Procedure** in the Information Sheet matches what you wrote in the Researcher Procedure (steps, time).
- **No hypothesis** in the Information Sheet or Participant Instructions; **hypothesis is** in the Debrief.

---

## What's Next (Week 18 — Phase 2)

- **Wednesday**: **MCQ Exam** (11 March).
- **Thursday lab**: Phase 2 — Recruitment Script, Data Recording Sheet, finalise Stimulus Materials, **complete** Researcher Procedure, **practice run** with your group, Research Study Order Form.

---

## Key Takeaways

1. The [Project Toolkit](project/project-toolkit.qmd) is your single reference: timeline, checklist, worked example, templates.
2. Phase 1 = participant-facing documents + start of Researcher Procedure.
3. Phase 2 (Week 18) = researcher-facing documents, materials, practice run, and order form. Finish both phases so you're ready for data collection in Week 19.
